packageRules.description: Never auto-open major bumps org-wide (open manually / review).
devDependencies: skip stability wait and auto-merge on green (they don't ship to prod). Council 2026-08-05.
Regular deps: auto-merge patch updates on green CI (low-risk semver). 2026-08-06.

hostRules.description: Auth for private @octetsolutions/* packages on GitHub Packages so Renovate can regenerate lockfiles. Token is a Mend Developer Portal secret named OCTETSOLUTIONS_NPM_TOKEN (org-scope). Migrated 2026-08-05 from embedded encrypted{} because Mend deprecated in-config encrypted secrets.
